# capture-repeated-usage

Provider: Codex.
Provider version: 0.51.0-alpha.2.
Source class: scrubbed capture.

Two actual token_count records from the same file, with intervening rows omitted. Usage info is identical but rate-limit reset changed. This is evidence that token_count is also a telemetry snapshot. Exact semantic turn membership is unknown in this minimal excerpt.

Expected output is a research oracle for the proposed standard, not current Nano output. IDs beginning `item-` are fixture-local logical IDs. Nulls mean no evidence. Captured arrays may be reduced to four entries; prose, paths, and identities are neutralized.
